The three .toml files are copied unmodified from that commit's
extras/alacritty/. As with vendor/cyberdream-nvim, these are the theme
author's own Alacritty exports rather than a third-party port, so the 16 ANSI
slots are authoritative and need no cross-check against another source.

GitHub's licence detector reports NOASSERTION for this repository because its
LICENSE carries two copyright lines — bamboo.nvim is derived from
navarasu/onedark.nvim — but the text itself is the MIT licence verbatim. Both
copyright holders are named in the LICENSE copied here.

Read at build time by readAlacrittyScheme in tools/external-scheme-sources.ts.
These files set neither a cursor nor a selection colour; see
external-scheme-sources.ts for what each is seeded with and why.
